why_ai: Generation is screen work that foundation models increasingly do in-house, with only privacy sign-off as friction.
why_clarity: Nobody can measure utility and privacy together, so the deliverable's success is contested.
why_digital: Real datasets in, synthetic data out, sold and delivered as software.

why_ai: Every evaluation component is a deterministic computation software runs without people.
why_clarity: Metrics already exist in the literature and give reproducible, instant results.
why_digital: Datasets in, evaluation reports out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Whoever defines the certification standard holds a position that outlasts any individual tool.
why_clarity: The standard does not yet exist, and its validity would be proven only over time.
why_digital: Machine-readable run logs in, standards and analysis out.

why_ai: Generation software competes with general AI models that produce synthetic records directly.
why_clarity: Generation runs recur at scale, but quality depends on modality-specific contests.
why_digital: Source data in, synthetic records out, licensed as a platform.

why_ai: Domain experts must judge plausibility, and one impossible record in a regulated domain ends the deal.
why_clarity: Constraint violations are checkable, but the constraint set is tacit domain knowledge.
why_digital: Regulated datasets in, synthetic records out, all on screen.

why_ai: Keeping joins and constraints intact is a mechanical problem with fully automated verification.
why_clarity: A generated database either survives the customer's queries and joins or breaks, instantly.
why_digital: Database schemas in, coherent synthetic databases out.

why_ai: Robotics and autonomy demand grows, though generative world models may substitute for simulators.
why_clarity: Sim-to-real transfer is measurable, but only after models are deployed on real sensors.
why_digital: Scene models in, rendered sensor data out, sold to engineering teams.

why_ai: Proofs of concept are nearly identical each time, ideal for an automated pipeline.
why_clarity: The same profile-generate-evaluate sequence repeats for every prospect with checkable results.
why_digital: Prospect schemas in, proof reports out, all remote.

why_ai: Multi-table synthesis is a hard technical problem, but no person or relationship protects it.
why_clarity: Constraint survival is checkable, but the privacy claim cannot be fully verified.
why_digital: Enterprise schemas in, synthetic databases out, entirely digital.

why_ai: An accountable officer must personally sign the release and answer for it afterwards.
why_clarity: No agreed approval artefact exists and a re-identification harm may never surface.
why_digital: Attack results and parameters in, a signed release decision out, inside the organisation.

why_ai: A credible certifier accountable for the combined guarantee is what customers need to rely on.
why_clarity: The two metric sets do not compose, so the claim has no agreed test yet.
why_digital: Datasets and evaluations in, certifications out, all remote.
